text:
mira: quick heads-up — I opened a small PR that sweeps the starter onboarding snippets for auth + first-deploy issues. PR #4321. Main changes: env var names standardized, Node SDK example updated to new client API, and a minimal Docker deploy step added. Pls skim when you have a sec and flag anything that would break existing tutorials.

jon: looking now. which env names did you pick? I want to avoid breaking old workshop slides.

mira: switched everything to REDWOOD_API_KEY (single canonical name) and added a note for orgs still using LEGACY_TOKEN. New README section shows both flows with a tiny migration snippet.

ashok: can you paste the updated Node code here? I want to validate the import pattern + async streaming bits.

mira: sure — here's the snippet in the PR (short):

```
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Hello world' });
console.log(res.text);
```

mira: also added a tiny Dockerfile snippet for first-deploy:

```
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json .
RUN npm install --production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","index.js"]
```

clare: thanks — can we keep a one-liner for users who want ephemeral tokens? we had questions in onboarding sessions.

mira: yes, added a short "rotate tokens" note and a curl example for exchanging a long-lived key for a short-lived token. left the enterprise KMS bit as a link to the private deployment docs.

jon: few nits: 1) change `res.text` to `res.output` (our latest SDK returns `output` for consistency), 2) add `await client.close()` in the example to avoid noisy CI warnings, 3) call out minimum Node version (18). Also, add a code comment about reading .env in dev.

mira: good catches. I'll update.

ashok: on streaming — we should not show streaming by default in the quickstart; it complicates error handling. Keep the simple sync example, but add an optional "streaming" appendix.

clare: I can take the migration blurb and make it friendlier for PMs. Will add a sentence that links to the migration guide.

docs-bot: PR #4321 has been labeled docs/quickstart and assigned to mira. Claimed by clare for migration copy and ashok for SDK verification.

mira: thanks @clare @ashok. ETA: I'll push edits in the next hour. If anyone wants to demo the new Docker flow during tomorrow's ramp, flag here. :raised_hands:
